instantsneak.midnightconfig.title: Configure Instant Sneak
instantsneak.midnightconfig.ANIMATION_SP: Controls the speed of the vanilla sneaking animation.
instantsneak.midnightconfig.SNEAK_HEIGHT:
Controls the camera Y position while crouching.
0.0 matches the modern vanilla height, 1.0 matches the old (pre-1.14) sneak height. 
Maximum value is 0.75 to prevent camera clipping.
